name: Corrected Job Applier — Weekly AI Job Hunter

parameters.content:
## ✅ SETUP — only 2 things to fill in

**1. Spreadsheet ID** — open the 3 green Sheet nodes and replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SPREADSHEET_ID` with the ID from your Google Sheet URL (the long code between /d/ and /edit). In each node also pick your Google credential (create it once by signing in with Google).

**2. OpenAI key** — open the *AI Resume Tailor* node and replace `YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY` with your sk- key.

Your Google Sheet needs 3 tabs named exactly:
`Jobs Found` · `Tailored Resumes` · `Application Tracker`

Then click **Execute Workflow** below to test. When it works, flip the toggle to **Active** — it runs every Monday 8am automatically.
